articles.title: Language Model Hallucination Evaluation with GraphEval
articles.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) commonly face 'hallucinations,' a significant issue during response generation. This problem arises when an LLM produces factually incorrect information, despite appearing confident. Understanding and mitigating these AI hallucinations are crucial for ensuring the reliability and trustworthiness of advanced language models, which is vital for modern technological applications and informed decision-making.

articles.title: Romania uses F16 to shoot down 'Shahed drone' over its territory for the first time as Putin unleashes new Ukraine strikes
articles.summary: Romania, a NATO member bordering Ukraine, utilized an F-16 fighter jet to intercept and shoot down a drone violating its airspace. This incident underscores the escalating security challenges for frontline nations amidst the Ukraine conflict, with drone incursions becoming frequent. It emphasizes the critical need for robust air defence and showcases NATO's preparedness to protect member sovereignty and airspace integrity.

articles.title: Lanterns Training Headquarters: Bleeding Cool Takes The Oath (IMAGES)
articles.summary: Bleeding Cool recently visited DC Studios' Lanterns Training Headquarters at San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC). This preview, featured at the annual international pop culture convention, offered a glimpse into content related to DC's 'Lanterns' series. While specific details from the visit are brief, such major entertainment events like SDCC are crucial for generating global industry buzz and fan engagement for upcoming projects, highlighting international media trends.

articles.title: ED searches 9 locations in Punjab, Jammu and Kashmir in narco-terror funding probe, freezes Rs 49.9 lakh
articles.summary: The Directorate of Enforcement (ED), Jammu Sub Zonal Office, conducted extensive search operations on July 23 across nine locations in Punjab. These operations were carried out under the provisions of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002. This action highlights the ED's ongoing efforts to investigate and curb financial irregularities and potential money laundering activities within the region, targeting economic offences.

articles.title: The Rise of North Korea’s Nuclear-Armed Navy
articles.summary: North Korea test-fired nuclear-capable cruise missiles from its upcoming guided missile destroyer, Kang Kon (52), on July 3, under Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's observation. This launch signifies Pyongyang's advancements in naval strike capabilities and its ongoing defiance of international sanctions. The demonstration raises regional tensions and global proliferation concerns, highlighting North Korea's persistent military development and unpredictable posture.

articles.title: Oil at $100 is pushing up costs from gas pumps to grocery aisles
articles.summary: Global oil prices have surged past $100 a barrel due to intensified fighting and military strikes linked to the ongoing Iran war. This escalation is expected to cause further economic hardship for consumers worldwide, who are already grappling with rising costs. The conflict highlights the significant impact of geopolitical instability on global energy markets and economic stability.

articles.title: Indigenous 'Bhargavastra' counter-drone system to complete internal trials in 2-3 months, says SDAL Chairman Satyanarayan Nuwal
articles.summary: Solar Defence and Aerospace Ltd (SDAL) is completing internal trials of its indigenous counter-drone system, 'Bhargavastra', within two months. This initiative boosts India's 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' mission in defence. 'Bhargavastra' will crucially enhance national security, providing the capability to detect and neutralize enemy drones, thereby strengthening India's defence against modern aerial threats.

articles.title: Delhi HC refuses to entertain PIL seeking NIA probe into CJP's Parliament march
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court refused to entertain a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) seeking an NIA or specialized agency probe into a march to Parliament on July 20, led by the 'Cockroach Janta Party'. The PIL aimed for an investigation into the protest, likely concerning its legality or security implications. However, the High Court’s refusal means the matter will not proceed for further investigation through this specific judicial request.
